about: Old ways a DLL now does better. find_holes.py reports a match as a lead, not a verdict: read the code first. Add an entry whenever an audit finds a new one; cite where the better way is documented.

entries.finding: Listens to BAG_UPDATE (one per bag, many per loot or trade) and rescans or coalesces the burst by hand.
entries.better: BAG_UPDATE_DELAYED: no payload, once per frame after any BAG_UPDATE (the keyring is not covered). Keep BAG_UPDATE only where the bag number matters.

entries.finding: Replaces GetContainerItemInfo for every addon to show items it holds (queued, reserved) as locked.
entries.better: C_Item.LockItem / C_Item.UnlockItem({bagID, slotIndex}): the client's own lock bit, so every bag addon greys the item and gets ITEM_LOCK_CHANGED. Client-side only; a server update for the item clears it, so keep the addon's own guard on the item.

entries.finding: Polls action slots for range every frame, or re-reads every button's usable state on each ACTIONBAR_UPDATE_USABLE.
entries.better: C_ActionBar.EnableActionRangeCheck(slot, true) with ACTION_RANGE_CHECK_UPDATE (fires on change only), and ACTION_USABLE_CHANGED (only the slots that changed). Keep an OnUpdate only while a button flashes or its tooltip is shown.

entries.finding: Walks all 120 action slots, usually to find where a spell sits or what a slot casts.
entries.better: C_ActionBar.FindSpellActionButtons(spell) / HasSpellActionButtons / IsOnBarOrSpecialBar for where a spell is; C_ActionBar.GetSpell(slot) for what a spell, macro or item slot casts.

entries.finding: Scans friends, guild or /who, often to remember players' classes. (The battleground scoreboard stays the source for enemies never seen, so it is not reported.)
entries.better: C_PlayerCache.GetPlayerInfoByName(name) and GetPlayerInfoByGUID(guid): group, nearby, friends, this session and ClassicAPI's saved cache.

entries.finding: Dismounts, leaves a form or stands up when a spell, an attack, a flight master, an NPC or an item fails for it.
entries.better: ClassicAPI's autoDismount, autoUnshift and autoStand (AddOn Options > ClassicAPI). They act before casts, NPC talk, object use, looting, item use, melee attack and the flight map, when the action is sent; retire the error handler.

entries.finding: Registers a unit event for every token. ClassicAPI fires unit events once per token, including every nameplateN, markN and focus, so a frame for a few units runs for every nameplate in a battleground.
entries.better: frame:RegisterUnitEvent(event, units...): the engine drops other units before Lua runs.

entries.finding: A unit button that targets, casts on or opens the unit menu by hand.
entries.better: Unit button attributes: SetAttribute("unit", u), type1 "target" (casts a cursor spell, drops a cursor item), type2 "menu"; hover becomes the mouseover. A child that keeps its own tooltip passes clicks on with owner:Click(GetMouseButtonClicked()). NamPower's SetMouseoverUnit stays right for such a child.

entries.finding: Replaces the Lua error handler, which hides errors from !ErrorLog.
entries.better: Let errors through; !ErrorLog collects them (/err).

entries.finding: Squeezes an own button into the game menu.
entries.better: InterfaceOptions_AddCategory(panel): Game Menu > AddOn Options.

entries.finding: A Frame dressed up as a StatusBar, redrawn in Lua on every value change.
entries.better: CreateFrame("StatusBar"); ClassicAPI adds SetReverseFill, SetFillStyle and SetRotatesTexture.

entries.finding: Reads or poses as ShaguTweaks, an addon not in this setup.
entries.better: Ask the DLL for the data (for sell prices: C_Item.GetItemSellPriceByID).

entries.finding: Parses combat chat text. (Honor gains have no structured event and are not reported.)
entries.better: COMBAT_LOG_EVENT_UNFILTERED with CombatLogGetCurrentEventInfo; NamPower spell events with IDs.
entries.source: ClassicAPI docs/API.md (combat log events); NamPower EVENTS.md

entries.finding: Reads information by filling a hidden tooltip and scanning its text.
entries.better: The structured C_ API for that data (C_Item, C_Spell, C_UnitAuras).

entries.finding: Walks auras by index; each index call re-walks the aura list.
entries.better: C_UnitAuras.GetAuraSlots(unit, filter, nil, nil, slots) then UnitAuraBySlot: one walk.

entries.finding: Draws its own countdown text over cooldown frames.
entries.better: Native Cooldown frames draw countdown numbers while the player's countdownForCooldowns CVar is 1; SetHideCountdownNumbers, GetCountdownFontString and the thresholds set them per frame. Read the CVar, never set it. The stock buttons' sweeps are 1.12 Models with none: give each a native Cooldown child with SetDrawSwipe(false), SetDrawBling(false) and the formatter, set from the CooldownFrame_SetTimer hook, with no timer (FostercareTweaks cooldown-numbers.lua, 2026-11-13).

entries.finding: Rereads every aura of the unit on each UNIT_AURA.
entries.better: UNIT_AURA_DELTA lists the added, updated and removed auraInstanceIDs; read each with C_UnitAuras.GetAuraDataByAuraInstanceID(unit, id, buf). Reread all only on isFullUpdate and when a token names another unit.

entries.finding: Compares OffhandHasWeapon() with a value. The engine returns 1 or nil, so a comparison with true or false is never right.
entries.better: Test its truth; IsDualWielding() when the question is whether the player dual wields.

entries.finding: Sorts by lowering both strings, which builds two new strings on every comparison.
entries.better: strcmputf8i(a, b) < 0: case-insensitive, makes no strings.

entries.finding: Packs strsplit's returns into a table; the returns go through the Lua stack first.
entries.better: strsplittable(sep, str [, pieces]) returns the array directly, with no stack limit.

entries.finding: Loops over the stance bar to find the active form.
entries.better: GetShapeshiftForm() returns the active stance-bar index, 0 for none; GetShapeshiftFormInfo(index) then gives its name.

entries.finding: Guesses the global cooldown from a 1.5 s duration; a rogue's or cat's GCD is 1 s.
entries.better: C_Spell.GetSpellCooldown(spell).isOnGCD says whether the reported cooldown is the GCD.

entries.finding: Checks the target's reaction next to a range check.
entries.better: C_Spell.IsSpellInRange / C_Item.IsItemInRange return nil for a unit the spell cannot be cast on.

entries.finding: Works out melee or ranged crit by hand (spellbook tooltips, agility formulas).
entries.better: GetCritChance() / GetRangedCritChance() return the engine's value with gear, buffs, talents and forms.

entries.finding: Calls a function the client always defines inside pcall; a failure is hidden from !ErrorLog.
entries.better: Call it directly. An error then reaches !ErrorLog.
entries.source: VANILLAFORGE.md, how we think: delete dead fallbacks

entries.finding: Tests whether a stock function exists before using it; the client defines it.
entries.better: Remove the test. Keep a guard only where the object may be a different widget type (a dropdown frame has no :Enable()).

entries.finding: Decides a bag's kind from English item-type text, one GetItemInfo call per slot.
entries.better: C_Container.GetContainerNumFreeSlots(bag) second return (family bitmask; equipped bags, and the bank bags while the bank is open), C_Item.GetItemFamily(item) for saved links. Read once per bag.

entries.finding: Walks a bag slot by slot to find or count empty slots. C_Container.HasContainerItem answers bags 0 to 4 only, so in the bank every slot looks empty.
entries.better: C_Container.GetContainerNumFreeSlots(bag) (count and family) and C_Container.GetContainerFreeSlots(bag) (the empty slots): carried bags, and the main bank and bank bags while the bank is open.

entries.finding: A handler works out whether it got this/event/arg1 or positional arguments.
entries.better: function(self, event, arg1, ...) : positional script arguments are the ClassicAPI default; XML bodies pass (this, event, arg1) explicitly.

entries.finding: SuperWoW's SpellInfo(spellID).
entries.better: GetSpellInfo(spellID) (ClassicAPI): name, rank, icon, cost, ..., minRange, maxRange, spellID, for any spell ID.

entries.finding: SuperWoW's UNIT_CASTEVENT also fires on every melee swing nearby. Fine when the addon reads MAINHAND/OFFHAND swings.
entries.better: For cast start, finish and failure only: NamPower SPELL_START_OTHER, SPELL_GO_OTHER, SPELL_FAILED_OTHER (registering the event enables it).

entries.finding: Asks UnitInRange for group members, usually from a repeating timer, whether or not anyone moved.
entries.better: UNIT_IN_RANGE_UPDATE (unitTarget, isInRange): fires only when the value changes, and the client checks only while a frame is registered. RegisterUnitEvent limits the units checked; RegisterEvent covers pet, party, raid and their pets. The first check does not fire, so read UnitInRange once when a unit starts to show. Group members out of view: UNIT_DISTANCE_CHECK_UPDATE (isInDistance) and UNIT_CONNECTION (isConnected).

entries.finding: Registers one stock event per power type (UNIT_MANA, UNIT_RAGE, UNIT_ENERGY and their MAX twins) and branches on the event name.
entries.better: UNIT_POWER_UPDATE / UNIT_POWER_FREQUENT and UNIT_MAXPOWER, all with (unitTarget, powerType "MANA"|"RAGE"|"FOCUS"|"ENERGY"|"HAPPINESS"). One registration, and for a visible unit they fire for every power, not only the primary. Mostly tidiness, not a speed-up: check the stock events do not fire as well before counting a saving. Pair with RegisterUnitEvent.

entries.finding: Shortens or groups large numbers by hand (1.2k, 12.3m, 1,234,567).
entries.better: AbbreviateNumbers(n) ("1.2K"), AbbreviateLargeNumbers(n), BreakUpLargeNumbers(n [, natural]); both take an options table with breakpointData for other suffixes. Output is fixed ("K", "M"): keep the hand-made one if the look must stay (lowercase k).

entries.finding: Builds a gold/silver/copper string by hand.
entries.better: GetMoneyString(copper [, separateThousands, useCoinIcons, checkGoldThreshold]); GetMoneyString(51234, nil, true) draws coin icons.

entries.finding: Reads the mount state, often from an aura or timer handler.
entries.better: PLAYER_MOUNT_DISPLAY_CHANGED fires when the player mounts, dismounts or changes mount; read IsMounted() inside it.

entries.finding: Hooks a tooltip's Set* methods one by one (SetBagItem, SetLootItem, SetHyperlink, ...) to add lines to item, spell or unit tooltips.
entries.better: OnTooltipSetItem / OnTooltipSetSpell / OnTooltipSetUnit / OnTooltipSetGameObject: one script per object type that fires after any Set* call (read this:GetItem()). Keep a Set* hook only for what GetItem cannot give, such as a bag slot's stack count.

entries.finding: Reads bag slots with C_Container.GetContainerItemInfo(bag, slot), which builds a new table per call; bag updates read every slot.
entries.better: Pass a reused table as the third argument (buf): the function fills it, clears missing fields and returns it; an empty slot returns nil and leaves it alone.

entries.finding: Keeps a chat history by copying every line from an AddMessage wrapper into saved variables, and replays it with AddMessage.
entries.better: smf:GetMessageInfo(index) reads a frame's lines (text, colour and extra values) when they are needed, for example at PLAYER_LOGOUT; smf:BackFillMessage(text, r, g, b, ...) restores them behind newer lines. No per-line wrapper.

entries.finding: Turns the full-screen world map into a window by hand (UIPanelWindows, scale, size, dragging).
entries.better: OctoWoW's client has a windowed world map: the map's minimize/maximize buttons, WorldMapFrame_Minimize/_Maximize and the saved WORLDMAP_WINDOWED. Use or extend it instead of a second window mode.

entries.finding: Reads cast times and sets a status bar's value (and a countdown text) on every frame.
entries.better: UnitCastingDuration(unit) / UnitChannelDuration(unit) give a duration object. statusBar:SetTimerDuration(duration, interpolation, direction) fills the bar by itself, and C_DurationUtil.CreateDurationTextBinding() writes the countdown text. Call again on UNIT_SPELLCAST_DELAYED / CHANNEL_UPDATE. Anchor a spark to the bar's texture so it needs no OnUpdate.

entries.finding: Finds proc alerts and glows by scanning auras or spell names.
entries.better: SPELL_ACTIVATION_OVERLAY_SHOW / _HIDE and _GLOW_SHOW / _GLOW_HIDE events, and IsSpellOverlayed(spellID).
entries.source: ClassicAPI docs/API.md#spellactivationoverlay (API only, the addon draws the art)

entries.finding: Reads the UI scale on a timer or every refresh to notice a change.
entries.better: UI_SCALE_CHANGED event: fires when the scale or window size is applied to UIParent.

entries.finding: Builds its own list of known names (group, guild, friends, whispers) for an edit box.
entries.better: C_AutoComplete.GetAutoCompleteResults(name, numResults, cursorPosition, allowFullMatch, includeFlags, excludeFlags) and IsRecognizedName. Alts saved across sessions are not covered.

entries.finding: Rechecks on a timer whether a plate frame still belongs to its unit.
entries.better: A unit that moves to another plate fires NAME_PLATE_UNIT_REMOVED (old frame) and then NAME_PLATE_UNIT_ADDED (new frame), REMOVED first. During REMOVED, GetNamePlateForUnit gives the leaving frame.

entries.finding: Sets a local raid mark by hand when solo, often by replacing SetRaidTargetIcon.
entries.better: NamPower's own SetRaidTarget falls back to a local mark when you are not in a group (NP_EnableLocalSetRaidTarget, on by default), for the mark keys, the unit menu and every other caller. Redraw your own frames after it if they need it: hooksecurefunc("SetRaidTarget", ...).
entries.source: NamPower README.md (NP_EnableLocalSetRaidTarget, Local Raid Marker Helpers)

entries.finding: Hides a Cooldown frame's native numbers to draw its own countdown text (a prefix such as ~, a color, minutes) on a timer.
entries.better: cooldown:SetCountdownFormatter(C_StringUtil.CreateNumericRuleFormatter()) with breakpoints such as { threshold = 0, step = 1, rounding = Up, format = "~%d" } and { threshold = 60, format = "~%dm", components = { { div = 60, step = 1, rounding = Up } } }; OnCooldownDone for the end. Numbers show while countdownForCooldowns is 1.

entries.finding: Drops unit events for other tokens in Lua, after the handler already ran for every token naming the unit.
entries.better: frame:RegisterUnitEvent(event, units...); for plates, the nameplate1..N tokens (grow the list when a plate takes a higher slot: FostercareNameplates FNP.RegisterPlateEvent).

entries.finding: Re-reads another unit's cast on a timer or every frame so the bar follows pushback.
entries.better: Nothing to follow: the server sends pushback only to the caster, so another unit's cast keeps its first span. Fill the bar with statusBar:SetTimerDuration from C_Spell.UnitCastingInfo times; end it on the cast events, with a slow backstop for casts the engine clears silently.

entries.finding: Registers ClassicAPI UNIT_SPELLCAST_SUCCEEDED for other units. A lead only when the addon also reads SuperWoW UNIT_CASTEVENT: that reports the same casts (SMSG_SPELL_GO, instants included) for every unit, so the token events add only de-duplication work.
entries.better: Keep one cast source: UNIT_CASTEVENT when swings matter too, otherwise NamPower SPELL_GO_OTHER; UNIT_SPELLCAST_* for the player or token-bound frames.
